title: Jack and Boule
tagline: Read the gravel. Point, shoot, win the end.
description: Pétanque from Provence with real rolling physics. Slingshot your steel boule toward the jack across generated gravel pitches, choose to point or shoot, and outplay five rivals.
howToPlay: Pull back on the screen like a slingshot, then let go to throw.
Pull length sets the distance and pull direction sets the aim.
Choose Roll, Half-lob, Lob or Shoot, and add backspin to stop short.
Read the slopes, sand and stones: the gravel decides where a boule stops.
The side with the closest boule scores. First to 13 wins.
